name: Bearing casing
overview: The central housing that supports the turbocharger shaft bearings between the turbine and compressor sections.
mainFunctions: Supports and locates the rotor assembly.
Maintains alignment between the turbine and compressor.
Accommodates bearing lubrication and sealing arrangements.
workingPrinciple: The turbine and compressor rotate together on a shaft supported by bearings inside this stationary casing. Lubrication reduces friction and carries away bearing heat. The oil supply, bearing type and seal arrangement depend on the turbocharger design.

name: Compressor casing
overview: The stationary air-side housing surrounding the compressor wheel and associated diffusion passages.
mainFunctions: Contains and guides the compressor airflow.
Collects compressed air and directs it towards the engine air system.
Supports the passages that convert airflow velocity into pressure.
workingPrinciple: The rotating compressor wheel adds energy to incoming air. Downstream diffuser and casing passages reduce its velocity and recover pressure. The compressed air then flows towards the charge-air cooler and intake system, where fitted.

name: Turbocharger cover
overview: A protective or closing cover fitted to the turbocharger assembly. Its exact purpose depends on which cover the model represents.
mainFunctions: Closes or protects the associated housing or access opening.
Helps prevent accidental contact or contamination where applicable.
Allows access for inspection or servicing when removed correctly.
workingPrinciple: The cover remains stationary while the rotor operates inside the turbocharger. Depending on its location, it may close a bearing space, protect an external area or form part of an enclosure. Verify its location before describing it as pressure-retaining, insulated or oil-sealing.

name: Air intake silencer
overview: An assembly at the compressor inlet that reduces noise generated by air intake and compressor operation.
mainFunctions: Guides air towards the compressor inlet.
Provides inlet filtration only when filter elements are incorporated.
workingPrinciple: Air passes through the silencer into the compressor. Acoustic passages or sound-absorbing materials reduce pressure-wave noise while allowing airflow. A combined filter-silencer also removes airborne contamination, but a silencer alone should not be described as a filter.

name: Turbine casing
overview: The hot-side housing that directs engine exhaust gas through the turbine stage.
mainFunctions: Guides exhaust gas towards the turbine wheel.
Directs gas towards the exhaust outlet after energy extraction.
workingPrinciple: Exhaust gas is guided through the turbine passages, transferring energy to the turbine wheel. The wheel drives the compressor through their common shaft. The casing remains stationary and withstands the temperature and pressure of the exhaust flow.
